note: The single source for the 11 canonical harness components and their picks (CP138, set 2026-09-07). /c, /c/[component], /stack and /api/stack all read this file, so the shelves and the recommended stack can never disagree. Deliberately holds NO score: a pick's Score and Signals are resolved live from lib/rank.mjs by armoryName, so a re-rank can never leave a stale number here. A pick whose armoryName is null is not a catalog row and renders as Not Indexed, never faked into the table. Our own repositories are picks only when they win on score. `plane` is the capability plane (CP138 axis 2): accounts an agent is provisioned onto, not open-source code, so never scored.
